notifications.title: Send notifications
notifications.description: Required: both true and false are valid answers, absence is not.

remoteWorker.title: Works remotely
remoteWorker.description: Shown as a switch rather than a checkbox.

handbookAccepted.title: I accept the employee handbook
handbookAccepted.description: Agreement: only true is valid. The widget does not imply this - const does.

payrollOptOut.title: Opt out of payroll emails
payrollOptOut.description: Nullable, so null is a permitted stored value.

legacyFlag.title: Legacy flag
legacyFlag.description: Holds the string "false", which is not a boolean at all.

importedCount.title: Imported flag
importedCount.description: Holds the number 0, which must not read as a deliberate no.

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.description: Checkboxes driven by array membership, not by a boolean value.

escalation.title: Escalation channels
escalation.description: The same checkbox group stacked vertically.
